title: Mixed Event — Wonder Magical Showtime! — Episode2 The Most Important Thing Right Now

meta.Episode: Episode2 — The Most Important Thing Right Now
meta.Event Outline: Phoenix Wonderland is faced with a transformation at the hands of Emu's brothers to appeal to the young adult crowd. In order to make sure it stays a place that makes everyone smile, Wonderlands×Showtime prepares a new show. In time, the curtain rises on a show unlike any other!

rows.Line: Phoenix Wonderland
Wonder Stage

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Okay, we have a plan for our show!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Next, we need to get everyone else to come and help us!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, but do you think they'll really be willing to? I mean, they all have their own shows to deal with...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: That is a concern. It may not be entirely realistic since they've all been working so hard to do well in this contest...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I have to think that the ones in contention to win will especially be unwilling to just toss everything aside on the final day.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
None of that matters right now!
We have to act! All of you, let's go!!

rows.Speaker: Emu & Nene
rows.Line: Right!
By the merry-go-round

rows.Speaker: Staff A
rows.Line: No, we won't be able to help you...

rows.Speaker: Staff A
rows.Line: This merry-go-round's going to be demolished. That's just that and I doubt your show will be able to change that...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: B-But... Well...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But if this show manages to get enough guests to come to the park, you might be able to save this merry-go-round. That's why we...

rows.Speaker: Staff A
rows.Line: This came from the very top. There's nothing any of us can do about it...

rows.Speaker: Staff A
rows.Line: I'm sorry, we're not helping.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh...
Hero Stage

rows.Speaker: Staff B
rows.Line: No, that won't be possible.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: What?! B-But why?!

rows.Speaker: Staff B
rows.Line: Why? Because we'd pretty much be disobeying a direct order, right?

rows.Speaker: Staff B
rows.Line: If we do this, won't we be risking having our pay docked or just getting fired outright?

rows.Speaker: Staff B
rows.Line: I mean, yeah, I like the way things used to be a lot more...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Then please help us! I beg you! If anything like what you said does happen, I'll do everything I can to stop them!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: If you believe that this plan has even the slightest chance of succeeding, won't you consider it?

rows.Speaker: Staff B
rows.Line: One show changing all of this? No way...

rows.Speaker: Staff B
rows.Line: Sorry, you'll have to find someone else.

rows.Speaker: PlaceInfo
rows.Line: Wonder Stage

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Emu! Rui!
How'd things go on your end?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
*Sob*... No one wants to help us...
How about you, Tsukasa?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: None of the four we asked were willing to help...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
I see...
I knew going in, but this is going to be quite a challenge...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Is this really even possible...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
No, we don't know yet...!
We have to ask everyone at every stage and attraction first!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah! So our next stop is...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
There...
I was hoping to have more of a backing before asking them for help...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
But we don't have a choice!
Let's go!
Phoenix Stage

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Tanomo!!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Stop, this isn't a dojo...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, right!
I almost did the same thing!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But we need that sort of energy right now.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hello, Phoenix Stage troupe!

rows.Speaker: Cast
rows.Line: Hm? Who's there?

rows.Speaker: Cast
rows.Line: Oh, is that...

Ah, so you've finally come...
Wonderlands×Showtime...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: That voice...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Sakurako Seiryuin...!

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: The very same. It's been some time since we last met. I've been waiting for you...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Heh. The last time we met was during our Christmas show, no, Sakurako Seiryuin?! Hm...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hold on. What did you mean by you've been waiting for us? Answer me, Sakurako Seiryuin!

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: Would you please stop calling me by my full name...?

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: Yes, it's a lovely and compelling name that just simply rolls off your tongue but...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But why were you waiting for us?

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: Ah, excuse me. Am I to understand that you've been trying to gather everybody in this park in an effort to put on an incredibly extravagant show?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Huh...?!
How did you know...?!

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: I happened to overhear your conversation while you were asking one of the other troupes to help.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: What? You were eavesdropping?

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: What?! No, I was there by pure coincidence...!

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: Anyways, I cannot let this pass without interjecting first myself...

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: This Show Contest is being held to attract more guests to this park. Why in the world are you trying to ruin that by essentially biting the hand that's feeding you?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Um, well...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: We know that what we're trying to do might not actually be possible!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: And we understand that it'll probably be a lot easier to get more people to come to the park if a big company from overseas helps us...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
But...!
That'll make everyone that loves and cherishes Phoenix Wonderland really, really sad...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Phoenix Wonderland isn't just a place for young people. It needs to be a place that can make everyone smile!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: That's why I want lots and lots of people to come here, and make it so they can all smile and laugh together!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: It doesn't matter how impossible it might sound. If there's still a way to make both of those things happen, I'm gonna try it!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
So please! I beg you!
Help us do this show!

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: You really think I'll agree to something like this just because you're wearing your heart on your sleeve...?

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: You're in the running to win this contest too, no? Are you sure about letting that chance just slip by?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Well...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: You still want to win the contest, don't you, Tsukasa...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hnng...
No, that's okay...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: However, I would be lying if I said that I don't mind not winning despite how much work we put into it...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (He worked so hard for this contest. Maybe I should...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We'll just have to find another opportunity...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Truth be told, winning this contest was my goal. If this problem didn't rear its ugly head, I would be doing everything I can to win right now.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But we have something much more important to deal with!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We have to save the Phoenix Wonderland that made so many people smile and laugh!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: As cast members of this park, we must always make sure that never goes away!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: To hell with this contest! There's something much greater at stake right now! We need to act!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Tsukasa...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Sakurako Seiryuin, this same feeling must dwell somewhere within that heart of yours! There is a part of you that knows this!

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: I'd rather not be lumped together with someone as obnoxious as you are...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: W-What?!

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: However, I do understand where you're coming from...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You do?

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: If it's my aid you seek, then you must present me a detailed plan first...

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: Regardless of my ultimate decision, that will be our first step.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Huh? Does that mean...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: You'll listen to our plan?

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: Three cheers for Seiryuin!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: To start, we'll need you to read this. We can further discuss any details after that.

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: Fine...

rows.Speaker: Cast
rows.Line: Wait, you're serious about this...?

rows.Speaker: Cast
rows.Line: It'd be amazing to actually pull this off but...

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: (They actually plan on doing this show...?!)

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: (I've never heard of any other parks doing anything like this. If we do somehow pull this off, it's sure to go viral, but this is beyond just challenging...)

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: (Yet... I can't get rid of this tingling sensation...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: What do you think, Seiryuin?

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line:
*Sigh*...
That's a rhetorical question, right?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We're rather proud of this plan so...

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: *Sigh*...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Please!
Help us put on this show!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Please...!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Please, join us. If you do, this show will definitely have a much greater chance at succeeding.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Help us, Seiryuin.
You're our only hope!
